verdict.rationale: The evidence pack offers only a generic claim of "API and integration support for extended workflows" and access to REST APIs. It never mentions an app marketplace or any prebuilt Slack, support desk, marketing, or data warehouse integrations an ops user could install. A REST API is a developer building block, and a vague integration claim does not show a marketplace exists.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace
